pages.text: An ion accelerated through V and bent by a field B moves on $(thing)r = √(2mV/q)/B$(). The $(item)Mass Spectrometer$()'s detector sits at 0.5 m: set the field for the mass you want. Cold clouds concentrate deuterium in their molecules thousands of times - a cheaper deuterium than heavy water. Lithium-6 can be picked out of lithium the same way.
